method: Primary-document review; bounded editorial relationship, not native application or fidelity testing.
description: Compare Windows personal PDF page reordering, permanent rotation, removal and extraction, with PDF output, in licensed PDF-XChange Editor, PDF24 Creator and the current free PDFgear offer. This covers page organization, not complete Acrobat text editing, signatures or secure redaction. Edition, maintenance and AI/cloud limits differ. Draft review; publication is not approved.
